insight.headline: Invalid Metafield Queries
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, such queries would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their GraphQL queries to ensure they are filtering by metafields that are properly set up. This change helps prevent incorrect results and makes it easier to debug queries. Developers should test their existing queries to identify any that may be affected by this change. The GraphQL Admin API will now provide clear error messages when invalid metafield queries are made, allowing developers to quickly identify and fix issues.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and reliable data, as invalid queries will no longer return incorrect results. This change will help prevent potential issues with merchant data and improve overall app performance.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the reliability and accuracy of the GraphQL Admin API, making it easier for developers to build robust and trustworthy apps. It also helps prevent potential data inconsistencies and errors that could impact merchant operations.
insight.code_example: query { products(metafield: { key: "my_metafield", value: "my_value" }) { edges { node { title } } } }

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, starting in API version 2026-10, instead of silently returning incorrect results.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Apps can now subscribe to events for various topics, including metafield changes, using the Events API.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, making it easier to build theme pages.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, making it easier for app developers to build merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview is now available, providing early access to new inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
The CLI has been updated to fix a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, affecting apps that store cardholder data.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2
updates.summary: The @shopify/cli-hydrogen package has been updated to add non-interactive shop and storefront creation flags.

updates.title: Updated App Store requirements: 4.1.2 Use a unique name for your app
updates.summary: The App Store requirements have been updated to include a unique name for each app, reducing merchant confusion.

updates.title: Storefront API `@inContext` supports `channelId`
updates.summary: The Storefront API @inContext directive now supports a channelId argument, allowing for specific sales channel context to be applied to queries.

updates.title: `productId`, `title`,`variantSku`, and `variantTitle` fields added to `ExchangeLineItem`
updates.summary: The ExchangeLineItem type now includes fields for productId, title, variantSku, and variantTitle.

updates.title: POS UI Extensions 2026-07 adds discount allocations to bundle components
updates.summary: The POS UI Extensions API now includes discount allocations for bundle components, starting with version 2026-07.

recap.headline: Enhanced GraphQL Admin API, Expanded Webhooks, and Improved Liquid Templates

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Updates
themes.detail: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries in API version 2026-10, ensuring more accurate results. This change affects queries that filter by metafields not set up for filtering.

themes.title: Webhooks and Events Expansion
themes.detail: New metafield triggers and topics are available for Events, allowing apps to subscribe to events for various resources like Order, Collection, and Location, as well as metafield changes on key objects.

themes.title: Liquid Templates and App Development
themes.detail: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, simplifying theme page building. Additionally, full-stack capabilities are introduced to power app analytics, reducing the need for external libraries and data warehouses.
